name: snippet
title: Snippet
description: A command to copy: the line, its prompt and a button that copies it.
use: One command a reader runs in a terminal: an install line under a heading, beside the main action of a hero, or as a step of a guide. The prompt cannot be selected, the command scrolls sideways instead of wrapping, and a quiet button copies it. A segmented control inside holds the same command for each package manager.

instead.when: It is several lines, or a file to read rather than a line to run
The reader types or edits the value
It is a key or a shortcut to press

keyboard.action: Reaches the command, which scrolls with the arrow keys when it is longer than the line, then the copy button
On the copy button: copy the command, once the page's script is attached
In the segmented control: choose another package manager, and its command is shown

platform.fallback: A long command scrolls the same, with clean edges instead of a fade where it goes on
The copy button is drawn even when scripting is off, and does nothing

classes.name: snippet
classes.description: The line: a well 38px tall, in the mono face, with the prompt, the command and the button in three columns

classes.name: snippet-sm
classes.description: A 32px line in 12px type; the default is 38px

classes.name: snippet-lg
classes.description: A 44px line in 14px type, for the head of a page

classes.name: snippet-prompt
classes.description: The prompt glyph, $ or >, in a quieter ink. It cannot be selected; mark it aria-hidden="true"

classes.name: snippet-command
classes.description: The command, on a <code>: one line that never wraps and scrolls sideways, fading at the edge where it goes on. Give it tabindex="0". With a segmented control, write one per option, in the same order; up to six

classes.name: snippet-icon
classes.description: The copy icon in the button, with icon. It steps aside once the status says the command is copied

classes.name: snippet-check
classes.description: The check in the button, with icon, after the copy icon. It takes the copy icon's place once copied

classes.name: snippet-status
classes.description: An empty <output>, not seen, which announces what the script writes into it. Written to, it turns the copy icon into the check; emptied, it turns it back

states.name: copied
states.description: The script wrote "Copied" into the status: the copy icon turns into the check. Empty it again after a moment

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: The whole line takes the focus ring

properties.name: --snippet-height
properties.description: Height of the line; the button is 8px less, 4px in

properties.name: --snippet-radius
properties.description: Circular radius of the well before the corner scale; the button and the options take it less their 4px inset

properties.name: --snippet-fade
properties.description: Length of the fade at an edge where a long command goes on

example: $ npm install @master/ui
